    A fleuron rule: a centred ornament flanked by tapering rules and beads

    fleuron_rule_grob.Rd

    A centred fleuron (a diamond with two beads) with a fine rule running out to each side. Each side thickens toward the centre and tapers to a point outward, with a few small beads strung along it, then an optional endcap. Built from circles and polygons only.

    fleuron_rule_grob(
  width = 0.9,
  thickness = 0.12,
  ends = "dot",
  centre = "fleuron",
  beads = 3,
  seed = NULL,
  variation = 0.5,
  ink = "#C9A227",
  name = NULL,
  gp = grid::gpar(),
  vp = NULL
)

    Arguments

    width

    Length of the rule in npc units (0-1).

    thickness

    Maximum thickness in snpc units (the shorter side of the viewport; keep the ornament box wide and short, e.g. 4 x 0.5 inches).

    ends

    Endcap kind for both ends: "dot", "diamond", "fleuron", or "none". See endcap_grob().

    centre

    Centre ornament kind: "fleuron", "diamond", "dot", or "none". See endcap_grob().

    beads

    Maximum number of beads along each side (0 for none).

    seed

    Integer seed for the small variations, or NULL for a random one.

    variation

    How much the seed may vary the shape, 0 (none) to 1.

    ink

    Colour.

    name, gp, vp

    Standard grob arguments.

    Value

    A gTree grob.

    Details

    With a seed, the length of the gap around the fleuron, the taper and the number and position of beads vary a little, so no two rules need match.

    Examples

    grid::grid.newpage()
grid::grid.draw(fleuron_rule_grob(seed = 7))
